thread:
emily: starting a staggered release for runtime v2.4.1 during 02:00-03:00 UTC. Plan: warmup 0.5% for 10m -> wave1 2%. Pin console to 1.5.1 and api to 2.0.2-compat. Router header-compat ON. Watch for header/casing errors and 5xx.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: runtime v2.4.1 warmup in +2m. Pins applied: console=1.5.1, api=2.0.2-compat. Track: /deploy/logs/6278901111

sam: FYI last run had header-casing mismatch causing ~0.6% 502s when router strict mode was on. header-compat should help but keep rollback gates strict.

infra-bot: [smoke] staging failures 3/400 (0.75%) at 2026-03-23T02:05Z. See /ci/6278901000.

emily: proceeding with warmup at 0.5% for 10m, rollback if >0.4% 5xx or p95 up +150ms sustained 5m.

router-team: seeing small spike on edge-7; proposing drain: edge-7 -> 15% from 50% for 15m, shift to edge-5/6.

deploy-bot: Traffic slice updated per emily. Edge-7 draining.

api-team: errors correlate with header validation rejects for legacy 'x-user-flags'. PR to broaden acceptance opened: runtime PR #512.

emily: pausing wave1 and scaling runtime v2.4.1 -> 0% for affected shards until PR merges and smoke passes. Keep pins.

deploy-bot: Wave1 paused by emily. runtime v2.4.1 -> 0% on shards [7,23]. Pins remain.

console-team: added release note clause: "If header-compat alerts or >0.4% 5xx, pause and pin affected shards; escalate to oncall."

sam: filing incident INC-7933 and linking PR #512.

emily: thanks team. We'll re-warmup after PR + unit tests, then re-run a short smoke before resuming wave1. Monitoring: https://metrics.internal/redwood/dashboards/rollout-6278901111
